name: diag_look_flip_summary_01
command:
import json,collections
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
source,ref=audited_result(Path('results/diag_look_flip_existing_01.json'))
records=[]
for line in Path(source['_meta']['log_path']).read_text().splitlines():
 if line.startswith('FLIP_EXISTING_DIAGNOSTIC_JSON: '):
  records.append(json.loads(line.split(': ',1)[1]))
assert len(records)==4
rows=[]
for d in records:
 pools=collections.Counter(str(c['flip_domain_nonempty']) for v in d['pool_counts_by_view'] for c in v['catalogs'])
 distribution=collections.Counter()
 for v in d['pool_counts_by_view']:distribution.update(v['retained_A_B_distribution'])
 row={'source':d['source']['file'],'attempts':d['counted_attempts_by_mode'],'rejections':d['counted_rejections_by_mode'],'native_failures_not_counted':d['native_placement_failures_not_counted_by_mode'],'pool_catalogs_by_flip_domain':dict(pools),'A_B_retained_pool_distribution':dict(distribution),'flip_ratio_records_without_detailed_target_measurements':d['flip_ratio_rejections_with_omitted_target_measurements'],'flip_funnel':d['flip_funnel']}
 rows.append(row)
out=Path('logs/review/diag_look_flip_existing_01');out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'existing authenticated diagnostics only; full per-view distributions in source log; missing measurements remain unknown','source':ref,'rows':rows},indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
lines=['# Existing Look Flip diagnosis','',
'The100-degree FloorPlan203 source has no recorded catalog with nonempty Look pools on both sides; all its72 catalogs therefore lack a Flip domain. At60 degrees only1 of76 recorded catalogs has both sides; no Flip was counted, and the exact scheduling/deadline cause for that one catalog still needs tracing. FloorPlan204 Flip attempts fail before any measured hidden-prefix gate: physical validity, target ratio or realized target mode. Retained detailed target measurements explicitly include closest_ratio_below_1_5; compact rejected records without those details remain unknown. The existing proposal code uses horizontal side distance and a12-point near-pool cap, while acceptance checks3D center distance. Next pilot changes only proposal order/domain and attempt allocation; final thresholds remain unchanged.','',
'| FOV / scene | Counted Flip / Stay | Catalogs with both Look sides / all | Uncounted native placement failures Flip / Stay | Flip rejection counts |',
'|---|---:|---:|---:|---|']
for d,r in zip(records,rows):
 cfg=d['source']['file'];fov='100' if 'look100' in cfg else '60';scene='203' if cfg.endswith('203.json') else '204'
 a=r['attempts'];p=r['pool_catalogs_by_flip_domain'];n=r['native_failures_not_counted']
 lines.append('| '+fov+' / '+scene+' | '+str(a.get('flip',0))+' / '+str(a.get('stay',0))+' | '+str(p.get('True',0))+' / '+str(sum(p.values()))+' | '+str(n.get('flip',0))+' / '+str(n.get('stay',0))+' | '+json.dumps(r['rejections'].get('flip',{}),sort_keys=True)+' |')
lines+=['','The existing per-unit funnel reports contain gate-level counts and up to three recorded rejection examples. Full per-view A/B distributions and source references are retained in logs/runs/diag_look_flip_existing_01.log; this table does not infer missing scenes or outcomes.']
(out/'report.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'report':str(out/'report.md'),'rows':rows},sort_keys=True))
